title: First Trace
intro: Walk to A and press Enter to leave an echo. Then take the path to the exit.
hints: Your echo retraces one step each time you move.
Step onto A and leave an echo. Take the other path in the next round.
Record ↑ ↑, then leave the echo. Reach the exit with → → → →.

title: Scenic Route
intro: Your echo fades after its last move. Time its arrival at A to match yours at the gate.
hints: The short path reaches A in two moves. The gate is four moves from the start.
Take the upper loop to reach A two beats later.
Record ↑ → ↑ ←. Leave the echo, then take five steps right.

title: Refrain
intro: Both gates open when someone steps on A. Your echo can visit A twice.
hints: The gates close as soon as A is empty.
After opening the first gate, have your echo step off A and back onto it.
Record ↑ ↑ ↓ ↑. Leave the echo, then take five steps right.

title: Relay Line
intro: One echo can open both gates. Send it past A on the way to B.
hints: Select a distant plate to see its gate. A opens the first gate and B opens the second.
The upper passage connects A to B.
Record ↑ ↑ → → → →. Leave the echo, then take seven steps right.

title: Two Voices
intro: Use two echoes to reach A and B on the same beat.
hints: One echo must be on A and one on B, with you at the gate.
Both echoes reach their plates on beat four. Find a four-step path to the gate.
Echo 1  ← ← ↑ ↑     Echo 2  → → ↑ ↑     Exit  ← ↑ ↑ → ↑

title: Interlace
intro: Let the first echo open a path for the second. Then use both to reach the exit.
hints: A opens the passage to B. The exit gate needs both B and C.
Send the first echo through A to C. The second can then pass the gate and reach B.

title: Turnabout
intro: Cross the arrow once to turn it around.
hints: The lower path needs A first and B second. The upper path reaches B first.
Record a trip past B to A, then come back through the reversed arrow.
Echo  ↑ ↑ → → → ← ←     Exit  eight steps right.

title: Tidal Shift
intro: Step on the diamond to swap the two bridges. The change lasts until the next visit.
hints: Your first crossing needs the folded bridge. Your second crossing needs the other bank.
Return to the diamond as your other self reaches the stone between the bridges.
Echo  ↑ ↑ ↓ ↑     Exit  six steps right.

title: Crosscurrent
intro: Two routes share one turnstile. A recorded echo always follows its original path.
hints: The lower lane takes two beats longer to reach the arrow. Give that lane to the echo.
Cross, step back, then cross again. When both of you land on the diamond together, it switches only once.

title: Counterpoint
intro: One echo opens the bridge. The next swaps it back. Both must finish at the exit plates.
hints: The left diamond opens both folded bridges. A lets the second echo reach the right diamond.
Send echo one through the arrow, back to A, then to C. Send echo two over the right bridge and through the A gate to B.

title: First Contact
intro: Find L, the lens. Two selves on its tile open the marked gate.
hints: The two arms take the same number of steps.
End one recording on L. Come up the other arm and meet it there.
Echo  ← ↑ ↑ →     Exit  → ↑ ↑ ← ↑ ↑

title: Borrowed Light
intro: After you meet at L, the two bridges need opposite banks on consecutive beats.
hints: The bridge touching L must be raised as you leave the lens.
Let your echo take one more step after the meeting. While you step onto the first bridge, it can reach the switch.
Echo  → ↑ ↑ ← ←     Exit  → ↑ ↑ ← ↑ ↑ ↑

title: Confluence
intro: The first gate needs two different places. The last needs the same place twice.
hints: At the elbow in the lower passage, look at where both echoes must be.
Send an echo to each plate. After that beat, have both paths turn inward to the lens.

title: Totality
intro: A recorded crossing survives even when the bridge beneath it folds.
hints: Record on the original bank. Both echoes must reach L, then return to their separate plates.
In the last round, flip the bank on your way to the lens gate. Your echoes can cross the folded bridges on the way back.
